description: Analyzes an experiment (default: the newest): the difference in MEDIANS of the outcome metric on the night after intervention days minus the night after control days, with a two-sided permutation test over the randomized pairs (the arms swapped within each pair; all swaps are enumerated up to 15 informative pairs, else 20000 random swaps with a fixed seed, so the same data always gives the same p; WITHOUT a washout the p-value is exact when the intervention does nothing, WITH a washout it is an approximation, checked by simulation in the project's tests, and `pValueBasis` says which), the effect against the same noise scale get_tag_effects uses (noiseThreshold = 3 * 1.25 * (IQR of the control nights / 1.35) * sqrt(1/nIntervention + 1/nControl), effectInStandardErrors), the nights per arm, the missing nights per arm, and a verdict. Both analyses are reported: intentionToTreat (every assigned day counts as assigned, followed or not; the PRIMARY one) and perProtocol (only days logged as followed; not protected by the randomization). verdict: 'insufficient' with fewer than 6 nights with a value in either arm (nothing is claimed; 6 is the least with which a permutation test over pairs can reach p < 0.05); 'intervention-higher' / 'intervention-lower' only when p <= 0.05 AND the median difference is larger than noiseThreshold (compared as printed); else 'no-clear-difference', which does not show there is no effect. `statement` says it in plain language, `randomized` says what was randomized and `notControlled` what was not (everything else on those days, no blinding, carry-over between nights, the watch's estimate, missing nights). Allowed only from the second day after the planned end (the last night must be recorded); before it an early look needs early: true and is flagged exploratory (exploratory: true, the statement starts with 'Exploratory'), as is a stopped experiment (analysed up to the day it was stopped). Reads Suunto's sleep list (and the recovery list for recoveryMorning), one request each, and the local file; writes nothing. A failed request is an error, never silently 'missing nights'. Output: { id, name, metric, today, status, exploratory, exploratoryReason, window: { from, through, plannedEnd }, hypothesis, verdict, statement, intentionToTreat: { nIntervention, nControl, interventionMedian, controlMedian, medianDiff, meanDiff, noiseThreshold, effectInStandardErrors, pValue, test: { method, permutations, informativePairs }, missingNights: { intervention, control }, verdict }, perProtocol (the same fields + note), adherence, randomized, pValueBasis, notControlled, thresholds, notes }. Read-only.

early.description: true: analyze before the planned end (exploratory, flagged as such). Default false: refused until the last night is recorded.
